claude.request:
Today's international headlines:
- Almost 1,000 arrested as clashes follow another day of mass protests across France: Hundreds of thousands took part in demonstrations in France, with protests also taking place in other European countries.
- Ukraine says Starlink connection 'now stable' after network limits: The slowed Starlink connections had affected the Ukraine's military and drone operations for a week.
- Palestinian families displaced as Israeli forces demolish Hebron homes: The crackdown follows the killing of two Israeli soldiers by two Palestinian gunmen on Friday - and comes just days ahead of Israel's election.
- Father who killed Oregon school gunman describes anguish over children he couldn't save: Kaylub Giamanco has been hailed as a hero for killing a teenager who fatally shot three children and a teacher.
- British woman dies after trying to rescue sons swept away at sea in the Bahamas: Nathan Gregory says the loss of childhood sweetheart Leanne "is unimaginable for our family".
- Vanessa Trump says she is cancer-free six months after revealing diagnosis: The ex-wife of Donald Trump Jr, with whom she shares five children, announced in May that she had been diagnosed with breast cancer.
- Three released without charge after fatal arson attack in Ireland: Three people - two women and one man - have been released, and one person remains in custody, gardaí say.
- White House lifts tariffs on some Canadian goods as midterm elections loom: From 30 October, tariffs will be eased on some products, including certain machinery, and placed on others, such as carpets.
- Two rescued after Nairobi building collapse with five still missing: Police have launched a manhunt for the building's owner and contractor after the multi-storey building collapsed while still under construction.
- Minneapolis withdrawal was 'surrender', Trump's ex-border patrol chief tells BBC: Greg Bovino was the public face of the controversial immigration enforcement operation in the city earlier this year.
- Oil spill washes up on UAE beaches after tanker strike: Satellite images show oil spreading for miles along the coastline, threatening local marine wildlife
- Fireworks and tear gas as protesters and riot police clash in Paris: The BBC's Europe correspondent reports from Paris where mostly peaceful protests turned into unrest after nightfall.

Tear gas clouds billow in thick, geometric shapes. One figure lies on the ground. Stark, high-contrast composition with deep shadows and sudden bursts of orange and red light from fires or flares. Graphic, almost woodcut-like style with bold outlines and minimal detail. Overhead view fading into ground-level chaos.
